1.title: Thousands in Michigan Got a Driver’s License With Someone Else’s Face on It
1.summary: About 8,200 people who applied for an enhanced driver’s license received cards in the mail with a stock image of a smiling man in the lower-right-hand corner.

2.title: Trump Administration Asks Supreme Court to Allow Voter-Screening Tool
2.summary: Voting rights organizations had challenged a Trump administration overhaul of a government database, arguing it could be used to disenfranchise eligible voters.

3.title: New Yorkers were 'lied' to about toxic air after 9/11 attacks, says Mamdani
3.summary: Newly released documents show toxins lingered for months after the attacks, but officials told people it was safe.

4.title: Israeli Allies Ban Trade With Settlements as U.K. Cites ‘Ethnic Cleansing’
4.summary: Britain, Canada and France on Tuesday announced sanctions on Israeli settlements in the West Bank, with Britain saying Israel had “turned a blind eye” to violence against Palestinians.

5.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
5.summary: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

6.title: Australian Social Media Users Could Get Power to Switch Off Algorithms
6.summary: Technology companies have been “running real-time, unregulated product testing on Australians” for too long, communications minister says.
